_about: Facts about the vanilla Azurik (Europe) default.xbe and the patches built from it (REORG_PLAN Step 2.4; Step RG.4a, at Europe's own VAs, for the packs that list Europe). Written only by scripts/gen_facts.py --region europe --update-facts; a protected path: the owner reviews every diff. No game bytes: vanilla spans are sha256s; patch_sites.*.new holds each build's bytes over the site, for the builds that change it, so a declared span may include vanilla bytes its pack already declares (Q67). Legacy sites (AZURIK_NO_SHIMS bytes) have no new: no build writes them.
